features.description: Gateway protocol v1 types, codecs, close classification, zero-copy 0xA1 parse; spec vectors + proptests

every spec §11 close row + unknown + 1006 classified and acted on (park vs reconnect)
keepalive after 120 s client silence prevents the 300 s idle close; idle close 1000 reconnects
capped exponential backoff with full jitter, anti-flap reset, ceiling under 500 failures; flapping 1000/1012 closes escalate (attempt reset only after stable_after); daemon status lines rate-limited

bounded queues with written policies: audio shed, control must-deliver, mic drop-newest, player drop counted; inbound queue also capped by bytes (4 MiB); link drains the uplink while waiting for inbound room
ordered shutdown, close frame sent, devices released, live tasks back to baseline; fits the 4 s budget even when the peer never answers the close (close_timeout 1 s, egress >= budget/2)
72 simulated hours, hourly drops: tasks/queues flat, heap growth 0 B; leak canary detects planted leak
loom model of the watchdog heartbeat (21808 iterations); a planted lost-update race is caught
fogar-agentd connects, serves status over UDS, SIGTERM -> exit 0 < 5 s, ledger start/clean, key not logged
